title: Past-only smoothing while retaining raw inputs
historical_evidence: User proposal; existing causal helper integrated into the canonical trainer. No scientific fits or runtime checks performed for this preparation.
primary_statistic: equal-quarter fold mean of within-fold mean paired per-fit WP deltas; no seed prediction averaging
decision_threshold_status: Predeclared allocation target, not a measured effect or universal significance cutoff. A +0.0005 mean WP justifies a dedicated input path and downstream distillation/serving work; uncertain smaller complementary signals can earn a separate blend study.
remaining_work: Run authored feature/causality/reload checks on the receiving host before scientific fits; tests were not executed locally.
Bind actual permitted datasets/cache identities and four source-qualified split manifests; inspect GPU/driver/CUDA environment and profile both real-shape arms.
Confirm complete fit->predict->score and paired normalization/order identities on the target host; memory, throughput and predictive gains remain unmeasured.
After 60 fits, run the declared paired seed/component uncertainty analysis; per-cell scoring is not the final 30-pair inference.

optimizer_starting_proposal.name: AdamW
optimizer_starting_proposal.status: bound by training settings; all-parameter decay follows canonical AdamW

schedule_starting_proposal.name: WSD
schedule_starting_proposal.status: bound by training settings and canonical --warmup-frac .02; horizon derived from actual full fitting loader

hardware_plan.cpu_inference_limit: submission work only: Python3.11,1vCPU,16GB,3600s,20MBZIP; no serving-fit claim

artifact_contract: separate evidence.tar, weights.tar and SHA256 manifest; no dataset auto-collection
integration_method: merge current research-team; preserve original source history

comparison.model: GRU H256 L2, dropout0, linear encoder, two output heads
comparison.features: raw112 + existing event features + 224 treatment/control channels
comparison.initial_state: first observed row, reset every sequence
comparison.targets: supplied labels, weighted MSE, no teacher/initializer/propensity
comparison.normalization: existing deterministic fitting-loader sample, fitted separately per arm/seed/fold; same selected rows, unchanged raw/event channels
comparison.checkpoint: fixed zero-based epoch11; no outer evaluation during fitting

training.weight_decay_policy: existing single AdamW group: all trainable parameters, including biases; no new exclusions
training.normalization_rows: existing fit_normalization: two fit batches, every seventh row
training.drop_last: existing canonical loader policy, recorded in sample order; no fitting subset

statistics.seed_interval: workflow crossed-seed bootstrap,10000 draws,RNG17017,conditional on four exposed folds
statistics.component_interval: workflow paired source-component bootstrap with fits fixed; separate from seed interval
statistics.multiple_comparisons: one primary contrast; any new half-life/model adds a new declared comparison family
statistics.selection_budget: one half-life32 and one architecture; no outcome-guided sweeps in this matrix
